leakage_prevention: features_at() filters transitions to releases <= origin; tests/test_job_evolution.py checks that features computed from a panel truncated at the origin equal those computed from the full panel
a training row enters fold T only if origin < T and its label event was published in a release <= T (asserted per fold in leakage_checks)
the 'high churn' threshold is the 67th percentile of training labels only
rows sharing one label event are down-weighted to total weight 1 (no over-counting of slow updaters)
AEI exposure (published 2025-2026) is excluded from the primary models and reported only as the flagged ex-post variant logit_aei_expost
hyperparameters are fixed in code (no tuning on test folds); the primary model was pre-specified

predictions_latest.interval: 10th-90th percentile over a lineage-bootstrap ensemble of 60 refits
predictions_latest.primary_model: logit (pre-specified); lgbm reported as a comparison
